headline: SharpLink CEO Warns Against New Ethereum Network Proposal EIP-8363
summary: SharpLink's Joseph Chalom opposes Ethereum's EIP-8363, but analysts say the reward burn is unlikely to pass.

headline: Circle Internet Group (CRCL) Launches Arc As Its Growth Story Moves Beyond USDC
summary: Circle Internet Group (NYSE:CRCL) launched its Arc blockchain in September, expanding its focus beyond USDC. Arc is being positioned as core infrastructure for institutional blockchain use, with an emphasis on compliance and integration with traditional finance. Founding validators on Arc include BlackRock, DTCC, Mastercard, Visa, ICE, and Standard Chartered.
